sources.title: GPT-2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GPT-2 GPT-2 is a scaled up version of GPT, a causal transformer language model, with 10x more parameters and training data. The model was pretrained on a 40GB dataset to predict the next word in a sequence based on all the previous words. This approach enabled the model to perform many downstream tasks in a zero-shot setting.
